Alteration Matrix

Source: R/figure-plots-matrices.R
PlotAlterationMatrix.Rd

Tiles in a row-by-column grid, coloured by a category (for example the alteration class of a gene in a tumour, or a clinical annotation of a patient); missing combinations are drawn in a light grey. Tiles can have rounded corners; a value per row (for example the share of altered tumours) can be printed right of the matrix, and row labels can be set in italics (gene symbols).

Usage

PlotAlterationMatrix(
  data,
  row = "row",
  column = "column",
  value = "value",
  fill_column = NULL,
  rows = NULL,
  columns = NULL,
  row_order_by = NULL,
  column_order_by = NULL,
  row_labels = NULL,
  column_labels = NULL,
  colours = NULL,
  missing_colour = "#F0F0F0",
  tile_width = 0.8,
  tile_height = 0.72,
  radius = 0.12,
  row_size = 5.3,
  row_pad = 3.5,
  row_italic = FALSE,
  show_rows = TRUE,
  show_columns = FALSE,
  column_angle = 55,
  column_size = 5,
  column_pad = 3.5,
  column_colours = NULL,
  right_text = NULL,
  right_format = "%.0f%%",
  right_size = 4.6,
  right_colour = "muted",
  right_offset = 0.2,
  legends = NULL,
  texts = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Long data: one row per matrix cell.

row, column

Columns with the row and column keys.

value

Column with the category of each tile.

fill_column

Optional column with explicit tile colours (overrides colours).

rows, columns

Row order (top to bottom) and column order (left to right): character vectors or data frames (ordered by a rank column if present); default first appearance.

row_order_by, column_order_by

Optional numeric columns of data giving the row or column order.

row_labels, column_labels

Display labels: named mapping or vector.

colours

Named colours per category.

missing_colour

Colour of missing cells.

tile_width, tile_height

Tile size in column and row units.

radius

Corner radius in data units (0 for square tiles).

row_size, row_pad, row_italic

Row label size, distance and italics.

show_rows, show_columns

Draw row or column labels.

column_angle, column_size, column_pad

Column label rotation (degrees), size and distance from the matrix (points).

column_colours

Named text colours of column labels.

right_text

Optional column with one numeric value per row, printed right of the matrix with right_format.

right_format, right_size, right_colour, right_offset

Format, size, colour and position (column units beyond the last column centre).

legends

Optional list of legends, each as the legend of PlotEmbedding() (shape "rect" gives patches); colours default to colours.

texts

Optional texts at panel fractions (list of label, xy, size, colour, bold, hjust, vjust, angle); labels may use FormatTemplate() placeholders filled from values.

values

Optional data frame for text templates.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

d <- data.frame(row = rep(c("g1", "g2"), each = 3), column = rep(c("s1", "s2", "s3"), 2),
                value = c("Missense", NA, "Deletion", NA, "Truncating", NA),
                share = rep(c(67, 33), each = 3))
PlotAlterationMatrix(d, colours = c(Missense = "#008300", Truncating = "#222222",
                                    Deletion = "#2a78d6"), right_text = "share",
                     row_italic = TRUE)
